channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Ai2 precomputes the entire planet: OlmoEarth v1.3 turns a year of satellite data into ready-made embeddings
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Allen Institute for AI released OlmoEarth v1.3 today — a satellite embedding model with precomputed annual embeddings for the whole planet at 10-meter resolution, a no-sign-in browser explorer, benchmark wins over Google's AlphaEarth on 20 of 27 tests, and a final pretraining bill of about $2,720 in rented H100 time.

item.title: Enact exits stealth with a $30M pre-seed to teach robots to feel — Yann LeCun and Mistral’s Arthur Mensch back the bet
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Zurich-based Enact Intelligence has come out of stealth with a $30M (€26.68M) pre-seed round — one of the largest in Europe to date — to give robots force-and-touch dexterity through their own actuators, backed by redalpine, Notion Capital, firstminute capital, Yann LeCun, Arthur Mensch, Andrew Lonsberry, and Hugging Face’s Thomas Wolf.

item.title: SUNMI pushes ‘Physical AI’ into the shop floor: new Hi SUNMI agent, Intel-built Windows devices, and a platform behind 40,000 merchants
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At its SDC 2026 developer conference in Shanghai, the Hong Kong-listed commercial-hardware maker (06810.HK) unveiled the Hi SUNMI AI agent for physical stores, a family of Intel-based Windows devices including the FLEX 3 WIN and T3 PRO WIN, and SUNMAX’s Magic AI agent platform — staking its claim on ‘Physical AI’ for commerce.

item.title: Assembler AI raises $4M seed to put computer vision over the factory workbench
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Montreal startup's Operator Vision cameras watch manual assembly stations and flag missed steps, wrong parts, and cycle-time drift in real time — now backed by Diagram ClimateTech Fund and a CEO with 25 years of AI company-building behind him.

item.title: WISeQey launches WISMind.AI: a trust layer for autonomous AI agents with verifiable IDs and quantum-proof credentials
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: WISeQey on Thursday launched WISMind.AI, a trust platform that gives autonomous AI agents cryptographically verifiable identities, signed and revocable permissions, and post-quantum-secure credentials anchored in a Swiss root of trust — with a developer program opening in the coming months.

item.title: Cognizant launches AI Nexus: an operating layer that meters AI spend, grades quality, and routes every model call
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cognizant on Thursday launched Cognizant AI Nexus, a modular, multi-model operating layer that meters AI spending, governs AI quality, and documents outcomes across teams — with its own research pegging unrealized AI value at $4.7 trillion.

item.title: Audit your AI agent in two minutes: a hands-on guide to iFixAi
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: iFixAi (ifixai-ai/iFixAi, Apache 2.0, 32,000+ GitHub stars) answers the one question agent evals skip — is your agent actually doing its job? — in under 120 seconds. This guide installs it, runs the free mock audit, reads the scorecard, and gets a citable grade from an independent judge.

item.title: FinBursa launches FinBursa 360: five AI agents and an orchestrator for private markets
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: FinBursa launched FinBursa 360, an AI-native front office for private markets: five specialized AI agents plus an orchestrator covering relationships, deals, due diligence, data rooms, fundraising and research — with human approval required before anything goes out.

item.title: UBS: don't bet on new US AI rules after the midterms — AI spend is now nearly 2% of GDP
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: UBS argues in a report dated October 22 that major new US regulations on AI are unlikely to emerge despite the technology becoming a central midterm-election issue — because too much is riding on AI's economic contribution, with hyperscaler capex projected at nearly 2% of US GDP in 2026.

item.title: DeepSeek closes in on a $15B raise: CATL and Tencent lead as the 100B-yuan round doubles its target
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: DeepSeek is wrapping up a funding round of about 100 billion yuan ($14.98B) with 15+ investors led by CATL and Tencent — double the original 50-billion-yuan target, Bloomberg first reported on October 22, with Reuters confirming the details.

item.title: Web of Science goes AI-native: Clarivate's Research Intelligence crosses 100 institutions across 25 countries
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Clarivate announced that more than 100 institutions across 25 countries and regions have adopted Web of Science Research Intelligence, its AI-native platform for research strategy, funding, and impact — five months after its May 2026 launch.

item.title: Run huge open models on your own PC: a hands-on guide to PolyStrata
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PolyStrata (VecSzn/PolyStrata, MIT, ≈365 GitHub stars) runs nine large open models — GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next among them — on an ordinary gaming PC, behind one localhost app and an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API your coding agents can already use. This guide installs it, picks a model that fits your hardware, serves it on http://127.0.0.1:8080, and wires it into Claude Code.

item.title: CGTN launches News Pal, an AI news companion that summarizes coverage of China and the world
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: China's state broadcaster CGTN launched News Pal, a web-based AI news companion that aggregates and summarizes reporting about China and the world. Its chat answers follow-up questions grounded in reporting, with links to the original articles.

item.title: Mobilint is building an on-device AI chip platform for humanoid robots — LG will validate it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Mobilint announced on October 22, 2026 that it is developing an on-device AI computing platform for humanoid robots — a co-designed NPU, hardware module and software stack that runs several AI models at once inside the robot, with LG Electronics set to validate it against its everyday-space scenarios.

item.title: Nuix launches the Neo AI Agent: agentic investigations with an audit trail built in
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nuix launched the Neo AI Agent on October 21, 2026: an agentic AI for legal, regulatory and criminal investigations that answers plain-language questions, links every answer to its source, and records each step it takes.

item.title: NVIDIA declares the 'ChatGPT moment for robotics' is near: Isaac platform gets a reference humanoid, Isaac Lab 3.0, and Schaeffler actuator twins
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At GTC Berlin on October 21, 2026, NVIDIA expanded the Isaac robotics platform with a full-stack Agile ONE SN reference humanoid, Isaac Lab 3.0, a new Isaac OS runtime, and open datasets — while Schaeffler made its actuator technology the exclusive foundational component of the Newton physics engine.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet: a proactive agent on Opus 5.5 that messages you before you ask
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet on October 21, 2026 — a proactive AI agent built on Opus 5.5 that sends a morning brief, monitors your connected apps, and works on its own cloud virtual machine. US Pro and Max users can join the waitlist.

item.title: Turn one sentence into an explainer video: a hands-on guide to Frametell's director agent
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Frametell (sitor-ai/frametell, AGPL-3.0, ≈365 GitHub stars) is a local-first app whose director agent turns one sentence — or your PDFs and notes — into an explainer video: you approve the storyboard, it writes and voices the narration, draws every page in your chosen style, and renders a 1080p MP4 with subtitles. This guide installs it, adds your keys, runs the studio and the one-command CLI, and ships your first film.

item.title: Railway halts every deployment after intruders may have accessed customer secrets — AI inference keys appear to be the target
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cloud platform Railway detected an intrusion on October 21 in the systems storing customer environment variables, warned that decrypted contents of some secrets may have been read, paused all deployments, and said the attack appears aimed at AI inference providers' keys.

item.title: PHP2Shell: an OpenAI model helped find the critical PHP flaws that triggered today’s emergency patches
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI says security firm Calif found one of two critical PHP flaws — CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 — using GPT-5.6 Sol. A leak forced the PHP project to ship emergency patches today.

item.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model largely built by AI — the first public test of recursive self-improvement
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Recursive, the startup led by ex-Salesforce chief scientist Richard Socher, has released its first model: Flint, a free Apache 2.0-licensed coding model that runs on a laptop — built in under four months, largely by the company's automated Eureka Machine research system.

item.title: NVIDIA DSX POD: the AI factory that ships in a box — 14 days from delivery to tokens
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA introduced DSX POD: complete Vera Rubin AI factories built inside modular containers and factory-tested before delivery — cutting deployment at a prepared site from six months to 14 days.

item.title: Anthropic turns Claude Security into a continuous scanner: findings tracked until the fix ships
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Security now watches connected repositories as code changes, marks each finding fixed when the fix lands, and plugs into existing workflows through an API and MCP connector — in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers with $25,000 a month in launch credits.

item.title: Legora raises $550M at an $8.8B valuation: the legal AI arms race moves from assistants to agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Stockholm's Legora announced a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation on October 21, 2026, led by Atreides Management — seven months after its Series D — as annual recurring revenue topped $200M and in-house legal teams became its fastest-growing buyers.

item.title: Make your coding agents talk across machines, encrypted: a hands-on guide to Reason Network
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Reason Network (reason-machines/reason-network, dual MIT/Apache-2.0 license, ≈893 GitHub stars in its first five days) is a small Rust daemon that lets coding-agent sessions on different computers see and message each other over end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer connections. Your agents get MCP tools to list teammates’ sessions, send messages, attach small files, and ask a human for sign-off. This guide installs it, joins a second machine, and sends your first cross-machine agent message.
